# Copilot Instructions

## Source of Truth

`source.md` is the single source of truth for all resume content. When generating, editing, or referencing resume content, always derive it from `source.md`. Do not invent or assume resume details that are not present in that file.

## Keeping Content in Sync

Whenever skills are added, removed, or renamed in `source.md`, the corresponding skill entry in `src/index.html` must be updated to match.

## Target Roles

This resume is being tailored for **senior software engineering** roles, including **senior frontend** and **senior fullstack** positions. When proposing edits, framing content, or suggesting emphasis, keep this target audience in mind.
